title: BEACON content_ja
description: Schema for schema/content_ja.json — BEACON source map and intelligence requirement registry.

intelligence_requirements.description: CU-GIR-aligned intelligence requirement entries. gir_id uses decimal format matching the Intel 471 CU-GIR Framework (e.g. 6.1.3.1). BEACON-specific org-context overlays append a dash-separated suffix (e.g. 6.1.3.1-JP-FIN).

sources.description: Intelligence source registry. Each entry carries tier/region/industry_focus/evidence_attack_groups for PIR → source candidate matching.

trigger_actions.description: Trigger-key → collection guidance text (Japanese). Keys match TriggerContext enum in src/beacon/analysis/threat_mapper.py.

gir_id.description: CU-GIR decimal ID, optionally extended with a BEACON org-context suffix separated by a dash (e.g. '6.1.3.1' or '6.1.3.1-JP-FIN').

name.description: Short human-readable label for this intelligence requirement.

mitre_attack_groups.description: ATT&CK Group IDs (Gxxxx format) associated with this intelligence requirement. Empty list means the requirement is cross-actor (e.g. ransomware, hacktivism) and source matching falls back to tier/region/industry only.

EEI.description: Essential Elements of Information — 5W1H intelligence questions per CU-GIR convention.

name.description: Display name for the intelligence source.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes this source covers, plus 'GLOBAL' for worldwide coverage.

industry_focus.description: Industry verticals this source covers. 'cross-sector' means the source covers all industries.

feed_url_hint.description: RSS/Atom feed URL hint for TRACE sources_candidate.yaml generation. Null when no public feed is available or URL requires Phase 3 verification.

tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol marking for this source's publications.

requires_membership.description: True when access requires paid membership or invitation.

evidence_attack_groups.description: ATT&CK Group IDs (Gxxxx) cited in publications from this source, auto-derived from MITRE ATT&CK external_references via scripts/derive_source_groups.py. Empty for sources using evidence_derivation='industry_consensus'.

evidence_derivation.description: How evidence_attack_groups was populated. 'auto:scripts/derive_source_groups.py' = ATT&CK bundle derivation. 'industry_consensus' = member-only or specialised source without ATT&CK citations; matches on region/industry criteria alone.
